messages:
harper: dropped a sketch for a compact sidebar regrouping. idea: group by "Resource" vs "Activity" instead of product surface. Resource = Models, Datasets, Deployments. Activity = Jobs, Runs, Alerts. looking for quick takes on breadcrumbs + deep-link stability

devon: i like the Resource/Activity split. breadcrumb Q: should breadcrumbs reflect the Resource group or the actual nav path? e.g., Models > Foo vs Resources > Models > Foo. i prefer the shorter model-first breadcrumb

lia: shorter breadcrumb is better for readability. proposal: breadcrumb shows type and item: "Model • Foo" and we keep an invisible nav-trail for internal telemetry only. that keeps links human-friendly

omar: deep-linking concern: some teams embed console links in runbooks. we must guarantee backwards-compatible routes for 6 months if we change path shape. consider adding route aliases that redirect 1:1 to new canonical path

yuki: accessibility nits: when a deep link lands on a nested panel, set focus to the panel heading and add role="main" on content container. also ensure breadcrumbs use a nav element with aria-label="Breadcrumb" and last crumb has aria-current="page"

harper: routing draft i'm thinking: canonical: /r/:resourceType/:resourceId(/:sub) alias old-style: /models/:id -> redirect to /r/model/:id. keep human-readable canonical but normalize for programmatic use

devon: minor copy concern: on collapsed sidebar the group headings vanish. we should show a transient header in the page chrome: "Resource: Models" when you first land so users know what group they're in

lia: UI detail: breadcrumbs should include context pills when deep-link targets a subview like metrics. e.g., Model • Foo  (metrics) — small pill that reads "metrics" and is keyboard-focusable

omar: embed scenario: support linking to a panel anchor plus a short token (for long filters). example: /r/model/m-9/metrics#p=latency&token=s_9x. token expires in 24h and is optional. document security considerations in the RFC

yuki: keyboard behavior: when arriving via deep link with anchor, ensure only one focus jump. focus panel heading, announce "Navigated to metrics for model Foo" via aria-live polite. avoid focusing internal interactive element to prevent unexpected keyboard activation

harper: good. i'll update the figma and the routing RFC to include aliases, token pattern, and breadcrumb pill interactions. will also add a compatibility note for 6 months with automatic redirects

devon: can we also add a tiny copy tweak: change breadcrumb separator from ">" to a centered dot "•" — less visual weight and aligns with compact chrome

lia: agree on the dot. also add tooltip copy for breadcrumb pills: "Context: metrics view — jump to related deployments"

nav-bot: updated RFC draft: https://docs.redwood/infranav/rfc/compact-nav-v1 (comments open) :robot_face:

harper: excellent. next steps: i'll iterate on the prototype with focus flows and share a quick QA checklist: deep-link landing, back-button after redirect alias, token expiry behaviour, aria-live announcements, breadcrumb pill keyboard order. thanks everyone :sparkles:
